title: Cannae: The Afternoon a Beaten Army Was Erased by Encirclement
summary: Tells how, on the second of August, two hundred sixteen BC, at Cannae in Apulia, Hannibal's smaller army drew the largest force Rome had ever fielded, under the consuls Varro and Paullus, into a double envelopment and destroyed it in a single afternoon.
